cases.name: Candace Anita Walters
cases.about:
"I just can't express in words how much she wanted to experience life," her daughter Holly said, her eyes welling with tears. "She loved life more than anyone I know."

Her mother was small and delicate, 5-foot-4 and about 110 pounds, but capable of a 20-mile hike in the Colorado woods. She had a small circle of friends, a close family and a powerful love of animals.

She wore out her pass to the Denver Zoo. After work, "she drove through Red Rocks almost nightly to look at the deer," Holly said. "She knew where the deer herds bedded down at night. The silvertail fox, she knew where he bedded down, so she would go up there and watch him."
